title: After the Nikkei Shinshun Hai: To a Garden Full of Roses

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Those cards in your hand,
those pieces on your board—
I see right through them all!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It matters not.
Then I shall simply surpass it—!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Ruler
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
(Woooaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude
once again, Ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...
What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I—haunted by the regret of letting the Arima
Kinen slip away,
had felt ever since as though I had dropped
something vital.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in a sense...
that was mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The stock I have nurtured from my debut
until now—no,
the lineage unbroken that my clan has carried
through the generations—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Spreading its roots far and wide among the
common folk, putting forth lush leaves
throughout the Classic year,
it had blossomed into a steadfast flower
at the Japan Cup and the Nikkei Shinshun
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Had I spent all my time looking down in
defeat since the Arima Kinen,
I never would have noticed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You ignited a flame within my heart and
lifted my gaze.
You opened my eyes to the lush foliage and
blooming flowers around me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Whatever your true intentions may have
been,
in the end...
this was all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't change the fact that
you are a powerful unit on the board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I shall make you taste a defeat so
crushing
that even your humble platitudes will be
blown clean from your mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Indeed, I shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"'—Both of you were amazing!'
'We'll be rooting for you in the Senior
Class too!'"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“This generation is way too stacked!”
“That pre-race interview was pure fire,
too!”

And so...
with an intensity unfitting for a mere GⅡ
race,
the Nikkei Shinshun Hai came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the ripples of that fervor—
spread outward into every corner.

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
Though Ruler-san herself stated she had no
intention
of treating it as a grudge match—

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
Speaking as a fan,
seeing both sides clash once again across
eras in a whole new form was ridiculously
hype!

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
“The racing world's history really connects
in so many ways,
huh.” “I'm getting pretty interested in the
Rosen Clan.” “What other Umamusume are
there?”

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
“Rose was simply incredible at the Japan
Cup.”
“I heard the Rosen Clan couldn't win a GⅠ
before,
but they racked up a ton of graded stakes wins,
huh.”

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
With things going like this,
I'm really looking forward to what the future
holds for the House of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I've felt it since the Japan Cup,
but with Rose Kingdom
putting up results like this,
there's no denying it—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The name of Rose Kingdom had taken hold.
Through this, the Rose Clan too came to be
recognized among the truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Through the Classic circuit, the Japan Cup,
and the Nikkei Shinshun Hai,
it was safe to say the prestige of the Rose
Kingdom had been firmly established.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What must be done next is clear. However—
before that,
there is one thing I wish to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It's time for revenge at the Grand Prix.

Speaking of the next major grand prix race
on the calendar,
it is the June showdown where runners are
chosen by fan voting—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I will answer the hopes of my people.
At the Takarazuka Kinen,
I shall gather everything I have lost
back into my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Will you stay by my side for the next battle
as well?
choice_data_list: I will always stand by your side.

text_block_list.text:
And so began the relentless days of
training,
racing toward their next trial:
the Takarazuka Kinen.
